# Code Of Conduct

Be respectful, constructive, and considerate of different experiences and backgrounds.

Do not harass, discriminate against, threaten, impersonate, or publish another person's private information. Keep technical feedback specific and focused on the work.

Maintainers may edit or remove inappropriate content and limit participation when necessary.

## Reporting Concerns

For harassment, spam, exposed personal information, or other GitHub policy violations, use GitHub's **Report content** or **Report abuse** tools. If reporting to repository administrators is available, you can select that route; otherwise, report platform abuse to GitHub Support. See [GitHub's reporting instructions](https://docs.github.com/en/communities/maintaining-your-safety-on-github/reporting-abuse-or-spam).

For a project-specific concern that needs private discussion, open a minimal request asking a maintainer to arrange a private channel. Do not name affected people or post sensitive details in that public request. No separate private mailbox is advertised by this policy.

GitHub Support handles platform-policy reports, not every project disagreement. For software vulnerabilities, follow the [security reporting policy](../SECURITY.md) instead. A public personal email address is not required to contribute to or publish this project.
